headline: Approved dozens of restaurant, store, and liquor license renewals, plus new licenses for two restaurants and a door-to-door sales company.
summary: Granted liquor, bar, and club renewals with stipulations after no one objected at the hearings. Approved a Sunday Ora Di Kafe event at 120 High Street and postponed the Isla Express license application to December 9, 2026.
decisions: Approved the records of the October 21, 2026 meeting as prepared by the Clerk.
Approved the consent agenda of door-to-door, peddler, and victualling house licenses on a unanimous voice vote.
Granted Class A liquor license renewals with stipulations, unanimous voice vote.
Approved the Pawtucket Wine & Spirits license renewal at 380 Cottage St., unanimous voice vote.
Granted Class T license renewals, unanimous voice vote.
Granted Class B limited and victualling house license renewals, unanimous voice vote.
Granted the Azul Tequila Bar & Mexican Grill tavern and victualling license renewal, unanimous voice vote.
Granted The Guild Pawtucket brewpub license renewal, unanimous voice vote.
Granted Class B and victualling house license renewals with stipulations, unanimous voice vote.
Granted Class D and victualling house license renewals with stipulations, unanimous voice vote.
Granted the Howard Rogers American Legion Post 25 Class D license renewal with stipulations, unanimous voice vote.
Approved the Ora Di Kafe petition at 120 High Street on Sundays, November 22 and December 20, 2026, unanimous voice vote.
Postponed the Isla Express license application at 584 Smithfield Avenue until December 9, 2026, unanimous voice vote.
Authorized Class B liquor establishments to stay open until 3:00 a.m. on New Year's morning, January 1, 2027, unanimous voice vote.
